HOME.description:
Detects when HOME screen loads successfully on XUMO & SKY and Rogers-Xfinity IUIv2 devices

[FIXED for Grep Compatibility - POSIX Extended Regex]
Reason: Updated to use POSIX-compatible regex patterns (no PCRE lookaheads/groups)
Now uses multiple alternatives with standard grep -E
Matches multiple HOME formats:
- QMS Bookmark (HOME_TILES - XXXX) load complete (Sky/XUMO with 'load' keyword)
- QMS HOME_TILES complete (XUMO simple format without 'load')
- App focus: Focus set to app with appId=com.entos.monarch_ui (Rogers IUIv2)

Tested and verified with: grep -E 'pattern' /opt/logs/sky-messages.log
